instruction: Fix the title and artist metadata tags for 'Zhou Xuan - Nights in Shanghai.mp3' in the Music folder — the tags are currently blank.

files.path: /home/user/Music/Huang An - I Know Missing is Painful.mp3

command:
import mutagen
path='/home/user/Music/Zhou Xuan - Nights in Shanghai.mp3'
try:
    f=mutagen.File(path,easy=True)
    title=f['title'][0] if f and 'title' in f else ''
    artist=f['artist'][0] if f and 'artist' in f else ''
except:
    title=''
    artist=''
print('title='+title)
print('artist='+artist)
